committedBeforeAnyRun: 2026-10-21 — fixed before the first run of this study; never tuned afterwards. A change is a second, labelled run.

data.note: Backtest cache only (backtest/data/cache/res-5 and res-D). No Fyers calls.

session.note: Minutes after midnight IST. A 5-minute bar starting at s closes at s+5. Entries only on bars whose CLOSE time is in [09:30, 14:45]. The bar closing at 15:15 (starting 15:10) is the forced exit; if a session has no such bar, the last bar of the session is used and counted as a data gap.

indicators.emaSeeding: EMA(n) runs continuously across sessions on 5-minute closes, seeded with the SMA of the first n closes of the dataset; alpha = 2/(n+1). Values at bar t use closes up to and including t.
indicators.vwapProxy: Index volume is 0 in the cache, so VWAP is not computable. 'VWAP' = the session's running equal-weight mean of 5-minute typical price (H+L+C)/3 from 09:15 up to and including bar t (a TWAP). The live engine also has no index volume and uses a tick-weighted reference; the two differ. Stated next to every result.

V0.label: plain crossover
V0.rule: LONG when EMA9 crosses above EMA21 at bar close (prev EMA9 <= EMA21, now >); SHORT mirror. No filters.

V1.label: trend alignment
V1.rule: SHORT when close < EMA20 AND EMA20[t] < EMA20[t-3] AND close < VWAP; LONG mirror. Enter at the close of the first bar of an alignment episode (episode = consecutive bars where all three hold).

V2.label: pullback rejection
V2.rule: While V1 alignment holds at bar t (SHORT): high[t] >= level*(1-0.0005) AND close[t] < level, for level = EMA20 or VWAP; enter at close[t]. LONG mirror (low[t] <= level*(1+0.0005) AND close[t] > level). Several entries per episode, each at least 3 bars after the previous V2 entry in that episode.

robustness.label: Allowed robustness check — reported separately, never used to select
robustness.rule: The 20 EMA is replaced by EMA n everywhere it appears for that run: alignment, slope, pullback level and trailing exit.

exits.stopRule: SHORT: max(high of bars t-3..t) + 5; LONG: min(low of bars t-3..t) - 5. Skip the signal (counted) if |entry - stop| > 80 points.
exits.trail: Exit at the close of the first bar after entry that closes through the trailing EMA against the position (SHORT: close > EMA; LONG: close < EMA). V0 trails on EMA20.
exits.stopFirst: From bar t+1 on, the stop is checked before anything else in each bar. If the bar opens beyond the stop, the fill is the open (worse); otherwise the stop.
exits.oneOpenPosition: A signal while a position is open is skipped and counted (not queued).

rUnit: R = (signed points - cost) / initial risk points, risk = |entry - stop|.

statistics.ci: 95% day-block bootstrap of expectancy R (backtest/compare.ts summarize: whole sessions resampled with replacement)

labels: config/trend_day.json (unchanged): trend-down / trend-up / chop from the res-D bar of each session. End-of-day information — evaluation only, never used for entries.
baselines: Current Nifty VWAP Reclaim, Opening Range Explosion and Trend Pulse detectors through the existing harness (backtest/run.ts --detectors ..., 5-minute), ungated and gated with the filter score as it would have been. Their exits are the harness's, not the study's.
